title: Design DNA
description: The exhaustive record of one design's identity. Never pasted whole into a prompt — the capped payload at the top of dna.md is what travels. Validate an emitted dna.json against this file.

medium_of_origin.description: Poster, landing page, slide deck, editorial spread, packaging…

provenance_note.description: Where the source came from, in one line. Recorded for the reader, never used to gate extraction.

samples.description: Multi-sample runs only. Every sample measured, each keeping its own mode. Exactly one entry has role 'anchor' — the anchor is what Step 5 reconstructs and diffs against, and its mode alone decides whether a field counts as measured. Omit entirely for a single-source run. All samples must be of ONE design system; different systems are never merged.

not_copied.description: Every real logo, wordmark, licensed photograph or proprietary face, with the substitution used. Part of the spec, not an apology.

remote_safety.description: URL mode only. Null or omitted otherwise.

name.description: Descriptive, e.g. 'dusty plum'. NEVER 'accent-500' — image and video models cannot read token names.

coverage_pct.description: The ANCHOR's measurement. In a multi-sample run this stays the anchor's number, never an average across samples.

coverage_pct_range.description: Multi-sample runs only: [min, max] of this role across all samples, measured on the shared role basis. Corroboration for the record — a wide spread is flagged in `confidence`, it never auto-demotes a rule and it never enters the payload.

measured.description: true only if scripts/measure.py produced it.

coverage_sums_to.description: Should be ~100. Record the actual sum so drift is visible.

accent_ceiling_pct.description: The bar on accent footprint in any output. Set it from the measured reference, not from a round number.

banned.description: Colour behaviours forbidden, e.g. 'no gradient on type', 'accent never exceeds 8%'.

family.description: Exact name where the mode can know it; otherwise a role description plus candidates.

identified.description: 'candidate' whenever the face was guessed from pixels.

fallback.description: REQUIRED. Silent Arial substitution is how a reproduction dies quietly.

display_to_body_ratio.description: The typographic signature. Record as a ratio, never as two pixel values.

body_pct_of_canvas_width.description: REQUIRED. Body size as a percentage of canvas WIDTH (14px on a 1280px canvas = 1.09). The one absolute in the record: 'space' is percentages-only and this object is ratios-only, so without it the spec contains no absolute anywhere and cannot be rendered at all.

ratio_floor.description: The value below which it stops looking like the reference.

steps.description: Relative multipliers of body, not pixels.

space.description: PERCENTAGES ONLY, so one spec drives a 1080x1350 carousel and a 1920x1080 slide without a rewrite.

margin_pct.description: Percentages of canvas. Omit any edge the source was cropped on — a viewport screenshot reports where the image was cut, not a design rule.

margin_pct_range.description: Multi-sample runs only: per edge, [min, max] across samples. `margin_pct` stays the anchor's own value. A tight range is evidence the margin is a system rule; a wide one is evidence it is not, and that goes in `confidence`.

negative_space.description: Where the emptiness is and how big, as a share of canvas.

absent.description: Absence is design. No shadows, no curves, nothing centred — record it with the same care as what is present.

how.description: AS A RATIO OR RELATIONSHIP, never an absolute value, and as a BAND rather than a floor — "5.5-6.5:1, measured 5.9:1", never "at least 5:1". A floor drifts and still reports a pass.

weird_move.description: The single deliberate break in the system. Its own key on purpose — it is the first thing a mechanical extraction loses.

found.description: false if none was found. Never fabricate one — a fabricated break gets reproduced every time. In a multi-sample run, also false when `occurrences.seen_in` is under half of `occurrences.of` — a break seen once across six samples is an accident, not a signature.

occurrences.description: Multi-sample runs only. How many samples the break appears in, out of how many were measured.

archetypes.description: Named layouts derived FROM THIS SOURCE. Without them you get consistent styling and inconsistent structure, which reads as sloppiness.

content_budget.description: How much text and how many elements before it stops being this archetype.

seen_in.description: Multi-sample runs only: how many samples this layout recurs in. Observed once across six samples, it is a page, not an archetype.

motion.description: Fill only when the source mode can see motion (video/GIF, or CSS/code). Omit for static work.

never_moves.description: What holds still is as load-bearing as what animates.

voice.description: Copy is part of the design.

bans.description: Written as absolutes. A prohibition steers harder than a permission, and one ban rules out an entire space in a line.

check.description: Binary and measurable. If two people could disagree about the answer, it is not a test.

scope.description: 'style' = decidable on any output in this style; these become the do/don't rules in dna.md. 'rebuild' = only decidable against the reference itself because it measures this source's own imagery, crop or content; Step 5 only, and quarantined in dna.md.

reconstruction.description: Step 5. A spec that has never rebuilt its own source has never been tested.

gaps_found.description: Every difference is a field the spec forgot. Record each one.

worst_relative_role_delta.description: Bar 0.25. Catches an accent doubling, which absolute points miss.

not_run_reason.description: Set when the mode could not be rendered.

confidence.description: Step 7. Every value inferred rather than measured, and every rule held under 70% confidence. This is where the style drifts first.
